data.strFullDescription: [p]This is a demo of the [b]House Builder 2[/b] game. You will be able to try 3 missions  in which the player will face construction tasks - from repairing a fence to building a full-size house.[/p][p][/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3691220/extras/e369375b0264327752335a08f2cb10f3.poster.avif?t=1760358885" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3691220/extras/e369375b0264327752335a08f2cb10f3.webm?t=1760358885" width="616" height="230"][/imgvid][/p][h2][b]Features of the demo:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Demo last roughly about 40 minutes but no one limits you to only completing tasks. The open world of the game is waiting to be explored[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Open World[/p][/*][*][p]Customizing the house with paint and furniture[/p][/*][*][p]Day and night cycle[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3691220/extras/34b5dc7b72f543ad3075885fd6fd14a2.poster.avif?t=1760358885" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3691220/extras/34b5dc7b72f543ad3075885fd6fd14a2.webm?t=1760358885" width="616" height="230"][/imgvid][/p][h2][b]MAIN FEATURES OF HOUSE BUILDER 2[/b][/h2][p]🛠️ [b]PREPARING FOR WORK[/b] [/p][p]Gear up and get ready—every job starts with the right tools and a plan! Firstly, you need to look at what you need for your next construction. Go to the local warehouse, buy it, and load it on the truck.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]🚚 [b]GETTING TO WORK[/b] [/p][p]Don’t be late or you can miss your ride. Load up, hit the road, and make sure everything gets delivered. On-site, before the job, you must unload all the stuff needed for the construction. [/p][p]  [/p][p] [/p][p]🌍 [b]TRUE OPEN WORLD[/b] [/p][p]Unleash your creativity in a sprawling open world teeming with possibilities. Explore it, find the place you want to work, and begin your job. The vast landscape is your canvas – shape it to your liking![/p][p][/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3691220/extras/d5792dac2324406629efbe93c138590b.poster.avif?t=1760358885" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3691220/extras/d5792dac2324406629efbe93c138590b.webm?t=1760358885" width="616" height="230"][/imgvid][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]🔨 [b]ADVANCED BUILDING MECHANICS[/b] [/p][p]Experience the next level of building simulation with advanced mechanics that offer more precision and control. Utilize a wide range of tools and materials to construct aesthetically pleasing and structurally sound homes. Take on challenging missions, complete building contracts, and unlock new tools and upgrades as you progress. House Builder 2 offers a dynamic gameplay experience that keeps you engaged and motivated to build and explore. [/p][p] [/p][p]🌈 [b]STUNNING COLORFUL GRAPHICS[/b] [/p][p]Dive into a visually captivating world where vibrant colors bring every detail to life. House Builder 2 offers a feast for the eyes, from the lush landscapes to the intricate interiors, ensuring every building project feels unique and beautiful.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Get ready to embark on the building adventure of a lifetime with House Builder 2. Whether you're a seasoned architect or a novice builder, there's something here for everyone. Grab your tools and start crafting your dream home today![/p]
data.strSnippet: Build, Explore, Create – Welcome to House Builder 2 Demo! From simple repairs to full-scale home construction. Experience the freedom of an open world, customize homes with paint and furniture, and dive into a day-night cycle that brings your building journey to life. Ready to build your dream home?
